We reject physical incompatibility rather than projecting it away. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Pure Neumann compatibility and mean gauge Solve singular2D Poisson with compatibility/gauge and reject incompatible source. Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Unit square N16/32/64, cell-centred point DOFs, cosine exact field, homogeneous Neumann; mean0 andN32 mean.25 probe. Editorial clarification A different linear solver of the same matrix is not an independent PDE discretization; no general boundary/MG claim. Adopted numerical method Shared-face differences, weighted-mean augmented solve and compatible CG comparison; no physical RHS mean projection. −Δu=f,∂nu=gN,∫f=−∮gN−Δu=f,∂n​u=gN​,∫f=−∮gN​ References and measured quantities Retain L2 refinement, nullspace/gauge/CG gap, source+1 rejection and boundary/source budget. Verification limits and failures A different linear solver of the same matrix is not an independent PDE discretization; no general boundary/MG claim.
